reviews.title: Bait and switched
reviews.text: This app isn’t free, it is in fact $25. Don’t waste your time. After spending the hour or so on setup, about a week will go by where you get used to the benefits, and then your apps will be held ransom unless you pay, claiming “Your trial has ended”. Nowhere on the Launcher website nor the app store is the existence of a trial or a paid version mentioned. This app is a carbon copy of Dumbphone, right down to the ludicrous pricing, but just even less transparent and harder to set up.

reviews.title: Bait & Switch
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and spent ten minutes setting it up. It was working fine until after a few days I click on the widget and it sends me to a page to pay for the app to continue using it because my “free trial ended.” Problem is, I never signed up for a free trial. I was never asked to pay until after I had already spent time setting it up and started using it. This is a sneaky bait & switch that wasted my time. Whoever decided to set up the app this way should be ashamed of themselves. If there is a fee, be upfront, don’t try to trick the users.

reviews.title: This app is perfect!
reviews.text:
Thank you guys for making this app free! In a market that is oversaturated by subscription based services (in this case, dumb phone/minimalist apps), this app stands out as being a great FREE tool for anyone to use. 

This app has all of the basic functions you could need for a minimalist/digital detox tool:

- No app icons, with the added ability to keep pages WITH app icons if desired.

- The ability to block certain apps indefinitely, OR make a custom schedule for when you can and cannot use certain apps.

I have certain apps blocked during work, and just before bed, and have noticed a dramatic change in my focus and sleep already. I highly recommend this app!

reviews.title: The In-Between
reviews.text:
I’ve been searching for the right “dumb phone” for a minute now, but it’s such a drastic change of life, sadly, that it’s hard to commit to. 

Minimalist Launcher provides that in-between area. An option. A parting of the clouds to show a little sun lol. Smart phones are necessary in our society, but they are slot machines. Stealing our time. Our attention. It’s a sad thing.

Minimalist Launcher isn’t perfect, but it’s exactly what I need right now. Keep my iPhone, but make it less interesting. It’s perfect in that way.

Very simple set up for me, guided along nicely by the prompts. Recommend it. We’ll see how much time I get back.
